title: Bulwer-Lytton offered the crown of Greece

tellings.quote: >> Look at Edward Bullwward Linton. At one point he was offered the crown of Greece and he declined it.

plain: The British writer Edward Bulwer-Lytton, author of the novel The Coming Race, was at one point offered the crown of Greece and turned it down, says the researcher Jason Jorjani, who mentions it in passing without giving a source. Jorjani raises it to show how much standing the novelist had, a man whose fiction he ties to the hidden history he describes to Michels.
